item.title: Evo announces expansions into 5 new countries, Fighting Game World Championship and local support after Saudi acquisition
item.description: <p>Late last week, the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/19/saudi-qiddiya-evo-ownership/">Saudi Arabia-owned RTS acquired 100% control over the Evolution Championship Series</a>, and it looks like they're already putting some big plans in motion.</p> <p>Organizers for Evo announced today their event calendar and details for the next five years including a number of new events and initiatives across the fighting game world.</p>
